cases.sentence: Находясь в желудке рыбы, Иона помолился Господу своему ___.
cases.translation: Being in the belly of the fish, Jonah prayed to Yahweh, his God.
cases.explain: The verb помолился (prayed to) takes the dative case with the preposition or without it.

cases.sentence: Я закричал, и ты услышал мой крик из глубин ___ мертвых.
cases.translation: Out of the belly of Sheol I cried. You heard my voice.
cases.explain: The genitive мира is used in the phrase 'depths of the world' to show possession.

cases.sentence: Ты в пучину меня вверг, в самое сердце ___.
cases.translation: For you threw me into the depths, in the heart of the seas.
cases.explain: The phrase 'heart of the seas' uses the genitive plural морей.

cases.sentence: Окружили ___, все твои волны и валы надо мной прошли.
cases.translation: The flood was all around me. All your waves and your billows passed over me.
cases.explain: The verb окружили (surrounded) is transitive and takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Я сказал, отстранен я от взора ___.
cases.translation: I said, I have been banished from your sight.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Окружили меня потоки, все твои волны обступили ___.
cases.translation: The streams surrounded me, all your waves encompassed me.
cases.explain: The verb обступили (surrounded) is transitive and takes the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: На дно, к самым корням гор я не шел, засовы ___ закрылись за мной навек.
cases.translation: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains. The earth barred me in forever.
cases.explain: The phrase 'bars of the earth' uses the genitive земли to show possession.

cases.sentence: Но ты, Господи, Бог мой, извлек меня из ___.
cases.translation: Yet have you brought up my life from the pit, Yahweh my God.
cases.explain: The preposition из (from) governs the genitive case.

reading.ru: Находясь в желудке рыбы, Иона помолился Господу своему Богу.
reading.question: Where was Jonah when he prayed to the Lord his God?
options: On the deck of the ship
In the belly of the fish
reading.correct: In the belly of the fish
reading.explain: The text states: 'Being in the belly of the fish, Jonah prayed to Yahweh, his God.'

reading.ru: Я закричал, и ты услышал мой крик из глубин мира мертвых.
reading.question: From where did Jonah say the Lord heard his cry?
options: From the bottom of the sea
Out of the belly of Sheol
reading.correct: Out of the belly of Sheol
reading.explain: Jonah prayed: 'Out of the belly of Sheol I cried. You heard my voice.'

reading.ru: Воды надо мной сомкнулись, бездна меня обступила, и водоросли голову оплели.
reading.question: What surrounded Jonah in the depths?
options: The waters, the deep, and seaweed wrapped around his head
reading.correct: The waters, the deep, and seaweed wrapped around his head
reading.explain: Jonah describes: 'The waters surrounded me, even to the soul. The deep was around me. The weeds were wrapped around my head.'

reading.ru: Когда жизнь угасала во мне, я Господа вспомнил, и дошла молитва моя к тебе, в святой храм твой.
reading.question: What happened when Jonah's life was fading?
options: He gave up and accepted death
He remembered the Lord and his prayer reached His holy temple
He called for help from sailors
reading.correct: He remembered the Lord and his prayer reached His holy temple
reading.explain: Jonah says: 'When my soul fainted within me, I remembered Yahweh. My prayer came in to you, into your holy temple.'

reading.ru: Я с хвалебными песнями буду жертвы тебе приносить, что обещал, исполню.
reading.question: What does Jonah vow to do?
options: Offer sacrifices to the Lord with thanksgiving and fulfill his vows
reading.correct: Offer sacrifices to the Lord with thanksgiving and fulfill his vows
reading.explain: Jonah vows: 'But I will sacrifice to you with the voice of thanksgiving. I will pay that which I have vowed.'

reading.ru: Господь повелел рыбе, и она изрыгнула Иону на сушу.
reading.question: How was Jonah rescued from the fish?
options: The fish died and washed ashore
The Lord commanded the fish to vomit Jonah on the dry land
reading.correct: The Lord commanded the fish to vomit Jonah on the dry land
reading.explain: The text says: 'Then Yahweh spoke to the fish, and it vomited out Jonah on the dry land.'
